verdict.rationale: Unleash Edge is a documented relay and caching layer that acts as a read replica serving thousands of connected SDKs. Targeting data such as user IDs and IPs is processed within the Edge node, which implies flags are evaluated at that layer rather than upstream. This satisfies the 'edge/relay layer' half of the story. missing for 10: evidence of CDN-worker runtime support (e.g., Cloudflare Workers), documentation on placing Edge nodes geographically close to users or the latency benefit, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
